text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text: O-Oh my?

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
It was amazing, no doubt about it... but...
did it lack the punch she had up until last year...?

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
“—Come to think of it, I might have heard about that.
Stories about how Orfevre's moods swing wildly.”

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Tsk.

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text: Look, she seems to be in a bad mood. Coming this far... some real cause for concern has popped up.

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
If... if that happened while we were overseas,
wouldn't that be the absolute worst?

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
I was totally sure I'd win, but...
Now I'm getting a little worried—

The murmurs of the fans reach my ears. But I could see an entirely different cause.
It wasn't that her running had become inconsistent—

It was likely unconscious.
Even while running, she occasionally had a puzzled look on her face.

In other words... something happened that forced her
to subconsciously hold back her power—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

Orfevre's ability is indisputable.
It didn't seem like she was being moody either... In that case, the likely reason would have to be—
choice_data_list: Orfevre, you're still not feeling well, are you?
Orfevre, you're still not feeling well, huh?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...What?
choice_data_list: Weren't you fussing around your chest area?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
...I do not know.
Find it yourself.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Heal it at once.
...It displeases me.

Orfevre whispered, leaning her weight against me.
Feeling her trust me with her weight made me feel—
though perhaps improper... genuinely happy.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: âAh, I knew it...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Huh, what's up?
Did something happen with Orfe?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
She looked a bit off when she was running...
I wondered if something was wrong, and I guess there really was.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, with that incredible run!?
I didn't notice at all. Wait, more like...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: You really keep an eye on Orfe, don't you, Shion-san?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, like a romantic vibe?
Just kidd—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: No way that's true!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I...!
Whether I like them, or hate them...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
It's not like that!
It's really not...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
She's so dazzling... so annoying...
That's why, if she falters, it just stands out that much more...!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I-I see...
Uh, is it kinda like that thing?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
By dazzling, you mean...
like Shion-san's light, huh. Haha.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Welp, good work today-ssu...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...Light.
After a brief checkup for the time being, no major abnormalities were found... so we decided to wait and see until the next race.

"Precisely because it was so minor,
even she ended up overlooking it.
...I must be even more careful myself."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —The Takarazuka Kinen.

"The Takarazuka Kinen is the Spring Grand Prix held at
Hanshin Racecourse. In other words, it carries the hopes
of the people... A victory truly necessary for a king."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: I'll make it known, just like this.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
The unpleasant gazes directed at me today...
by the foolish rabble.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
I will carve it into their minds
that all of those were needless worries.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
So that none may ever dare defy Me again.
I possess not a single flaw.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Do not ask.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
The one who should be questioned
is you.
choice_data_list: ...I'll definitely make sure it'll be fine!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
I heard you loud and clear.
Don't go back on your word.

And so, while monitoring her condition,
we proceeded with training
toward our next target race: the Takarazuka Kinen.
